protocol_scope: local structured handoff between SteelAI T60 roles
rules: Sender and receiver must be different registered T60 roles.
Evidence references are identifiers and digests, not raw payloads or local paths.
Every revision binds the task identity, roles, evidence, status, timestamps and result summary.
request_id is stable across related tasks and runs; each concrete tool execution emits its own run_id.
The envelope cannot grant human approval or formal-write authority.
Network discovery, streaming, push notification and vendor-specific A2A extensions are out of scope.
